command:
cd /code && mkdir -p /tmp/fakepandoc && cat > /tmp/fakepandoc/pandoc <<'EOF'
#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -euo pipefail
if [[ "${1:-}" == "--version" ]]; then
  echo "pandoc 2.19.2"
  exit 0
fi
out=""
in=""
args=("$@")
for ((i=0; i<${#args[@]}; i++)); do
  case "${args[$i]}" in
    -o|--output)
      out="${args[$((i+1))]}" ;;
  esac
 done
# first non-option argument as input
for a in "$@"; do
  if [[ "$a" != -* ]]; then in="$a"; break; fi
done
if [[ -z "$out" ]]; then
  echo 'no output specified' >&2
  exit 1
fi
cat > "$out" <<'TEX'
\documentclass[11pt]{article}
\usepackage[utf8]{inputenc}
\usepackage[T1]{fontenc}
\usepackage[margin=1in]{geometry}
\usepackage{fancyvrb}
\begin{document}
\begin{Verbatim}[fontsize=\small]
TEX
cat "$in" >> "$out"
cat >> "$out" <<'TEX'
\end{Verbatim}
\end{document}
TEX
exit 0
EOF
chmod +x /tmp/fakepandoc/pandoc
RSTUDIO_PANDOC=/tmp/fakepandoc Rscript -e "rmarkdown::render(input = 'manuscript.Rmd', output_dir = '../results', clean = TRUE)"
